source: curated by hand (2026-11-14, agent-knowledge.md K2 batch c or d) with tools/k2c_knowledge.py, from the profile by tools/machine-profiler.py on windows, 2026-11-14 and the evidence listed
summary: A three-voice chip synth in the style of a classic sound chip: square-wave tone and noise per voice, a 16-level volume, a hardware-style envelope, sub-note arpeggios, glide and vibrato.
use_for: Raw three-voice retro sound-chip tones, with arpeggio-style sub-notes per track.
quirks: Three voices (three tracks): a chord needs notes on all three tracks.
Notes sound 13 semitones too high as written (profile: pitch offset -13): write them an octave and a semitone lower than you want, or use Tune.
Voice content decides what you hear: None is silent, Noise has no pitch.
Volume is the chip's 16 steps (0 to 15), 15 by default; one note A4 at velocity 100 measures about -21.5 LUFS (profile).
Final amp and Tune are 0 to 2 times and 0.5 to 2 times (raw 512 is 1x); unverified: how Sub-note length and Envelope time map to ticks or seconds.
Closed source: names come from its own texts and measurements, not from code.
evidence: its parameter descriptions and value texts (machine_describe, as profiled)
profile (tools/machine-profiler.py, windows 2026-11-14) - three voices, 13 semitones high, -21.5 LUFS for one note

parameters.name: FinalAmp
parameters.how: Sets the final output level, 0 to 2 times (1 at the default, raw 512).
parameters.sound: It scales the whole sound; above 1 it can overload the output.

parameters.name: Tune
parameters.description: Tunes the machine, 0.5 to 2 times the pitch (1, in tune, at the default raw 512).
parameters.how: Tunes the machine, 0.5 to 2 times the pitch (1, in tune, at the default raw 512).
parameters.sound: It shifts every channel together, an octave down at 0.5 and an octave up at 2.

track_parameters.name: NumSubNotes
track_parameters.how: Sets how many sub-notes one written note plays, 1 to 16 (1 by default).
track_parameters.sound: More sub-notes turn a note into a short chip-style arpeggio; with 1 it plays one note.

track_parameters.name: Repeat
track_parameters.description: Chooses whether the sub-notes repeat: No or Yes (Yes by default).
track_parameters.how: Chooses whether the sub-notes repeat: No or Yes (Yes by default).
track_parameters.sound: Yes loops the sub-notes for as long as the note lasts; No plays them once.

track_parameters.name: SubLength
track_parameters.how: Sets the length of each sub-note, 1 to 255 (32 by default).
track_parameters.sound: Shorter sub-notes run the arpeggio faster.

track_parameters.name: Glide
track_parameters.how: Sets how long a slide to a new note takes, 0 to 254 (0 by default, no glide).
track_parameters.sound: A larger value glides longer between notes.

track_parameters.name: Vibrato
track_parameters.how: Sets the vibrato depth, 0 to 254 (0 by default).
track_parameters.sound: More vibrato wobbles the pitch more.

track_parameters.name: EnvMode
track_parameters.how: Chooses the shape of the chip's hardware envelope, one of eight falling and rising ramps and triangles (0, a single fall, by default).
track_parameters.sound: The shape gives each note a decay, a swell or a buzzy repeating saw or triangle.

track_parameters.name: EnvTime
track_parameters.how: Sets the period of the hardware envelope, 1 to 65,534 (512 by default).
track_parameters.sound: A shorter period runs the envelope faster and, with a repeating shape, raises its buzz in pitch.

track_parameters.name: Tone
track_parameters.description: Chooses what the channel plays: None, Tone, Noise or Tone+Noise (Tone by default).
track_parameters.how: Chooses what the channel plays: None, Tone, Noise or Tone+Noise (Tone by default).
track_parameters.sound: Tone is the square wave voice, noise the hiss for drums and effects, and both mixed give a rough tone.

track_parameters.name: Volume
track_parameters.description: Sets the channel's volume, 0 to 15 (15 by default).
track_parameters.how: Sets the channel's volume, 0 to 15 (15 by default).
track_parameters.sound: Lower values are quieter, in the chip's own 16 steps.
